doc: May a reply that was generated for `target` be written into the input box of what is on screen now (`live`)? The live side is READ FRESH right before the write, not taken from a cache. Messages are [side, text] with side 'her' or 'me'. `expect` is the shared decision; a platform-specific `expect_android` / `expect_windows` overrides it and marks a known divergence that S2 has to close (or keep on purpose). A false refusal (copy instead) is acceptable, a false fill never is.

proof_rules.android: the last 6 visible messages ('side:text' joined) must equal the ones at generation, and be non-empty
proof_rules.windows: the newest visible message (side, text) must equal the one at generation

cases.name: same title, another chat with the same name (different newest message)
same title, a new message arrived
same title, the window shows no messages (empty tree / scrolled away)
the candidate carries no generation proof
not a chat screen (list / settings / payment page with an editable node)
only an older message differs, the newest is the same
cases.divergence: Windows compares only the newest message; Android compares the last 6.

cases.name: the live title cannot be read, messages match
cases.divergence: Android lets matching messages stand in for an unreadable title; Windows refuses without a readable title.

cases.name: the candidate has no conversation title, messages match
cases.divergence: Android treats a blank target title as unusable and relies on the messages; Windows refuses a candidate without a conversation.
